jobs.title: Education Program Manager
jobs.description:
Hudson Global Scholars Operating LLC provides the best U.S. education to our school partners and students around the globe through the combination of best-in-class curriculum, highly qualified instructors, and personalized learning experiences. Our HGS Network schools offer students the opportunity to earn a U.S. high school diploma and prepare to enter top universities.

**The Role**

The Program Manager is the primary relationship owner for our partner schools and resellers in the United States. You'll work directly with Site Coordinators at partner schools and reseller partners to ensure successful program launches and high quality support throughout the school year.

You'll serve as a two way bridge. With partners, you'll represent our schools by explaining, supporting, and standing behind company policy. Internally, you'll be the eyes and ears of Operations, bringing partner feedback, risks, and opportunities to the right teams. You'll work within established standard operating procedures and a seasonal cycle of processes tied to the academic calendar.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILTIES**

**What You'll Do**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for Site Coordinators at assigned partner schools and resellers throughout the partnership.
* Plan, launch, and support programs for your accounts, following standard operating procedures and the seasonal calendar.
* Explain and support company policies, set expectations, and resolve issues in a way that protects both the partner relationship and our brand.
* Capture partner feedback, identify risks early, and route issues and opportunities to leadership and internal teams, including Registrar, IT and Engineering, Project Management, Teaching and Learning, and Customer Support.
* Support both direct school partners and reseller partners, understanding the distinct needs of each.
* Coordinate the onboarding of our technology at partner sites.
* Use the CRM and our Student Registration Management system to track interactions, maintain accurate records, and manage account activity.
* Monitor account performance, analyze data, report on trends, and take corrective action when needed.
* Contribute to partner annual plans and long term goals with leadership and Business Development.
* Support the growth of your accounts by identifying ways we can better meet partner needs.
* Manage the demands of program launches and peak enrollment periods.

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in a related field
* Experience in program management, account management, or partner relations, preferably in education
* Familiarity with online programs, program launches, and technology at school sites
* Experience with CRM systems, HubSpot preferred
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office and experience with project management tools
* Excellent communication and relationship building skills
* Strong organization, time management, and attention to detail
* Ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities, especially during peak seasons
* Comfort following standard procedures consistently while adapting to new tools and processes
* Fluency in a second language is a plus

Hudson Global Scholars is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Hudson Global Scholars is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Hudson Global Scholars will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations.

We are Builders FirstSource, America’s largest supplier of building materials, value-added components and building services to the professional market. You’ll feel proud of the work you do here every day to transform the future of home building and help make the dream of home ownership more achievable. At BFS, we believe building a successful career is not solely defined by a degree. Your experience, skills, and passion are just as important, if not more so. As such, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace that welcomes candidates from all backgrounds and experience levels.
  
  
PURPOSE
  
Own the end-to-end planning, coordination, and execution of deployments across business, technology, and operational teams. The Deployment Manager ensures each release is ready to deploy, dependencies and risks are understood, and all required activities are coordinated through go-live and stabilization.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  

* Own the integrated deployment plan across business and technology workstreams.
* Drive deployment readiness across environments, data, integrations, testing, training, communications, cutover, and support.
* Coordinate dependencies across application teams, infrastructure, vendors, business teams, and other programs.
* Establish and manage deployment milestones, entry/exit criteria, and readiness checkpoints.
* Facilitate deployment readiness reviews and provide a clear view of risks, issues, dependencies, and decisions.
* Own the cutover plan, including sequencing, ownership, timing, dependencies, contingency planning, and command-center readiness.
* Ensure open defects, technical issues, and operational risks are understood and appropriately incorporated into deployment decisions.
* Coordinate Go/No-Go preparation and ensure decision-makers have a concise, fact-based readiness view.
* Drive resolution and escalation of deployment blockers.
* Coordinate go-live execution and transition into hypercare/stabilization.
* Capture lessons learned and continuously improve the deployment approach across releases.

What This Role Owns vs. Partners On
  
Deployment Manager owns Partners with
  
Integrated deployment plan Program / Project Managers
  
Deployment milestones Product & Business teams
  
Cross-workstream deployment dependencies Technical Integration PM
  
Readiness governance QA / Testing
  
Cutover planning & coordination Release / Engineering teams
  
Go/No-Go readiness view Change, Training & Communications
  
Deployment risks & escalations Business Operations
  
Go-live coordination Service / Support teams
  
Hypercare coordination Workstream leads
  
  
Success Measures
  

* Deployment plans are integrated, current, and understood across workstreams.
* Critical dependencies and risks are identified early and actively managed.
* Readiness is transparent ahead of Go/No-Go decisions.
* Cutover activities have clear owners, timing, and dependencies.
* Deployments move into production with appropriate business and technical readiness.
* Issues during go-live and stabilization are rapidly coordinated and resolved.

Experience / Capabilities
  

* Strong experience managing complex enterprise deployments or releases.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate across business and technical teams.
* Strong integrated planning, dependency management, risk management, and executive communication skills.
* Experience with cutover, release readiness, Go/No-Go governance, and production stabilization.
* Comfortable operating across multiple workstreams without replacing the accountability of individual workstream owners.
* Strong facilitation skills with the ability to drive decisions and escalate effectively.

**Scope of role:**  

* Project: Typically manages medium to large projects and/ or part of programs.

The primary focus of each role can be different depending on the role but may include some combination of each of the responsibilities outlined below. Team members should work with leadership to define the "composition" of their specific role to drive impact and generate outcomes. **Status Updates and Progress:**

**Collaboration:**

**Change Management:**

jobs.title: Program Manager - EDS ECHO
jobs.description:
**Position:**  EDS ECHO Manager

**Reports to:** Educational Programs Director

**Location:** UK or US, Remote Based

**Working Hours:** Full-Time, 9AM-5PM UK/ET

**Contract:**  Fixed-Term (12 months with annual opportunities for extension)

**Salary:** £41,000 / $53,000 per annum (de*pending on location)*

**Revised:** October 2026

**Organization Overview**

The Ehlers-Danlos Society is dedicated to improving the lives of people affected by Ehlers-Danlos syndromes (EDS) and hypermobility spectrum disorders (HSD). Through research, education, and collaboration, we work to accelerate diagnosis, improve access to effective clinical care and management, and accelerate the development of dedicated therapeutic treatments.

Our vision is a world in which every person living with EDS or HSD receives timely diagnosis and equitable access to the right treatment and care for their individual needs.

**Overview of Responsibilities**

The EDS ECHO Manager leads the day-to-day delivery of EDS ECHO, with line management responsibility for the EDS ECHO team and accountability for the program’s operational and administrative functions.

Working closely with the Educational Programs Director and teams across The Society, the Manager also contributes to the strategy, development, and delivery of the wider educational portfolio as it evolves and grows. The role provides project management and oversight of program governance, supporting quality, sustainability, and progress against agreed targets.

Through this work, the Manager ensures that EDS ECHO contributes to The Society’s work to address the most pressing challenges affecting people with EDS and HSD by accelerating diagnosis, driving the development of treatments and therapies, advancing access to care, and educating and connecting the community.

**Key Responsibilities/Essential Functions**

***Department Administration and Management***

· Line manage the EDS ECHO team, setting clear priorities, delegating responsibilities, reviewing performance, and supporting professional development.

· Lead operational planning and delivery of EDS ECHO programs and courses, overseeing workloads, resources, and timelines to ensure effective delivery.

· Oversee program administration, ensuring the team maintains accurate databases, calendars, communications, website content, and session resources.

· Establish and maintain clear procedures and quality standards, ensuring facilitators, speakers, and session administrators understand their responsibilities and follow agreed guidelines.

· Oversee preparation of program agendas and session materials, working with the team and facilitators to ensure content is timely, relevant, and aligned with program objectives.

· Coordinate Continuing Medical Education (CME) and CEU applications and associated requirements, with support from the Educational Programs Director & CMO.

· Manage relationships with facilitators, speakers, external administrators, and participants, providing guidance and resolving escalated issues.

· Use team and facilitator meetings to review delivery, address challenges, share learning, and agree actions.

· Identify operational risks and opportunities for improvement, implementing changes and escalating significant issues to the Educational Programs Director.

· Provide hands-on administrative and session support where required to maintain continuity of delivery and respond to team needs.

***Society Operational Management***

· Monitor and evaluate EDS ECHO performance against agreed KPIs and strategic objectives, contributing to quarterly board reports with updates on progress, achievements, challenges, and priorities.

· Track and report income from EDS ECHO programs to the Educational Programs Director, supporting financial oversight and program sustainability.

· Work closely with the Educational Programs Director, Content team, and Events team to support content development for Society summits and other educational events, recommending topics, themes, and potential speakers informed by stakeholder needs and program insights.

· Contribute to the strategic development of EDS ECHO and the wider educational portfolio, working with the Educational Programs Director and Executive team to identify opportunities aligned with The Society’s objectives.

· Coordinate operational planning and project delivery across the educational portfolio, monitoring timelines, resources, risks, and dependencies.

· Maintain effective program governance, reporting processes, and procedures, using evaluation findings and stakeholder feedback to inform improvements.

· Provide flexible support across the Educational Programs team as required, contributing to wider team priorities and activities as needed.

· Actively develop personal capability relevant to the role and apply learning to strengthen both program performance and leadership effectiveness.

· Define (with leadership input as needed) and maintain a practical measurement framework that supports funder reporting, internal decision-making, and continuous improvement.

**Work Environment**

Under normal conditions, this role is a fully remote position, working from home. However, due to the international nature of the Society’s work, staff may be required to travel to company events, meetings, and conferences as well as some weekend work.

**Requirements**

***Knowledge & Interpersonal Skills***

· Strong knowledge of program management and development, including operational planning, governance, evaluation, and continuous improvement.

· Ability to translate strategic objectives into practical plans, priorities, and measurable outcomes.

· Strong people management skills, with the ability to delegate effectively, support staff development, and build a collaborative team.

Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Today our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity and driven by responsibility. We’re optimists for change and we help clients initiate, navigate and benefit from transformation. We believe optimism is a force multiplier, helping clients to mitigate downside and maximize opportunity. With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our 3,000 consultants serve clients worldwide from 48 locations in 19 countries. Our expertise delivers results. Our optimism transforms outcomes.

**About Sia Experience-Marketing Advisory**

Sia Experience is the end-to-end marketing and customer experience arm of Sia. Agile and collaborative, our Marketing AdvisoryBusiness Line is recognized for delivering high-impact, growth-focused solutions by blending marketing, CX, creative, AI, and deep industry expertise.

As strategic partners, The Marketing Advisory team empowers clients across technology, luxury, consumer goods, finance, energy, and more to scale operational excellence and drive brand-led growth through AI- and data-driven strategies. Our teams lead full-funnel marketing transformations—from strategy and go-to-market execution to experience design, performance measurement, and sustainable impact.

It’s an exciting time to join us. SiaX has long been the agency behind some of the world’s biggest brands—now we’re expanding, becoming one of the most recognizable names for companies that demand bold, business-driving creative. We’re shaping SiaX into the go-to agency of the future. This is your chance to be part of that growth, working alongside top-tier creatives, consultants and agency leaders to continuously evolve what a modern, full-service agency can be. Opportunities like this don’t come around often—if you want in on the next level, this is it.

 **Job Description**

Contract roles are geared toward independent professionals interested in temporary or project-based work.

*Sia Title:* Project Consultant (Exempt Contractor)

*Project Title:* Program Manager

*Level:* Mid-Senior

*Project Length:* This is a temporary position with an expected duration through 6/30/27

*Project Hours:* 40 hours per week $80-90/hour

The expected compensation for this contract is per year. The exact pay rate will vary depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to skills, experience, and location.

*Location:* Remote

**About the role**

Sia is looking for a contract Program Manager to run app store listing management for a flagship consumer app. You’ll be the single owner of everything that shows up on the App Store, Google Play, and the Chrome Web Store, from intake through publishing. You’ll also build the operating model for the work, drawing on how best-in-class consumer app teams run theirs.

**What you’ll do**

* Run the intake process for app store content updates, triaging requests and working with Product Design, Production Design, and Product Marketing to get creative developed
* Upload and publish content directly to the App Store and Google Play, owning release accuracy and timing
* Own weekly screenshot updates across 10+ surfaces, including iOS (6.9" and 5.5"), Android phones, iPad, Android tablets, Apple Watch, Android Watch, CarPlay, Android Auto, and the Chrome Web Store
* Coordinate localization with the international team and submit localized assets for every supported language (it’s a manual process today, and we want you to find ways to improve it)
* Enable strategic creative updates to the listing, including in-app events, custom product pages, and new App Store surfaces that drive growth
* Build the resourcing model and operating processes for app listing management

 **Qualifications**

* Experience managing app store listings, ideally for a high-traffic consumer app
* Hands-on familiarity with App Store Connect and Google Play Console
* Strong program or project management skills, including managing intake, prioritization, and tight weekly release cycles
* Comfort working across design, marketing, product, and international teams
* Attention to detail. Accuracy and timing matter here
* Ability to work independently and bring structure to a process that’s still taking shape
* Experience with localization workflows is a plus
* Experience with custom product pages, in-app events, or app store optimization is a plus

 **Additional Information**

**Work Authorization**

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application and throughout their employment. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship now or in the future.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Medical Communications
jobs.description:
Are you a highly organized project management professional who thrives in a fast-paced client services environment? Precision AQ is seeking a Program Manager to play a critical leadership role in the successful delivery of medical communications programs. In this position, you will partner closely with Scientific Directors, Strategic Account leaders, clients, and cross-functional teams to drive project execution, maintain operational excellence, and ensure timely delivery of high-quality work. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys balancing client partnership, process management, financial oversight, and team collaboration while contributing to impactful healthcare communications programs.

### **About You**

* You are a highly organized project manager who can successfully oversee multiple projects, stakeholders, timelines, and priorities simultaneously.
* You are a proactive problem solver who anticipates challenges, identifies risks early, and develops effective solutions.
* You excel at building relationships and communicating clearly with clients, vendors, and internal teams.
* You enjoy working in a collaborative environment and serving as a key operational leader across complex programs.
* You have a strong attention to detail and take pride in maintaining accurate project documentation, financial tracking, and workflow processes.
* You are comfortable providing guidance and mentorship to junior team members while supporting their professional growth.

### **About the Role**

As one of the three core leaders of the account team, the Program Manager is responsible for developing, managing, and communicating project workflows that ensure successful execution of client programs. You will serve as a vital operational partner to Scientific Directors and Strategic Account Directors/Managers, providing visibility into timelines, milestones, resource needs, financial performance, and project status.

In this role, you will oversee project workflows, coordinate medical/legal/regulatory (MLR) review processes, manage project documentation, and support financial tracking and invoicing activities. You will act as a primary client contact for project status updates, operational discussions, and financial communications while ensuring compliance with relevant client and industry requirements. Additionally, you may manage program logistics, coordinate vendor activities, and provide guidance and support to Program Coordinators.

### **Required Experience**

* Bachelor's degree required.
* 1–3 years of project management experience within a pharmaceutical-related service business such as medical communications, healthcare advertising, sales training, or digital production.
* Demonstrated experience managing multiple projects, timelines, stakeholders, and deliverables in a deadline-driven environment.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with clients and cross-functional teams.
* Experience supporting project budgets, financial monitoring, invoicing, or resource planning activities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and project management tools.
* Ability and willingness to travel as required.

### **Helpful Experience**

* Experience managing Medical, Legal, and Regulatory (MLR) review processes.
* Knowledge of scientific publication planning processes and Datavision.
* Experience working with vendors, meeting logistics, or event planning activities.
* Previous experience coaching, training, or mentoring junior project management professionals.

### **Who We Are**

Precision AQ - Medical Communications was founded with the simple belief that the scientific story is the foundation of every pharmaceutical brand. Our teams of inquisitive problem solvers and passionate creators dig deep to translate the science behind today's cutting-edge therapies, then communicate the science clearly and credibly. Our proven track record of long-tenured relationships with major pharmaceutical companies and leading bio-tech firms, and our inclusive, open-minded team culture are industry leading. This passionate work environment, paired with growth opportunity, professional development, compensation, and benefits, are why Precision AQ - Medical Communications was recognized as a Best Place to Work by the Philadelphia Business Journal for the last three years.

Are you ready to join a team committed to providing the best in science and strategy?

Any data provided as a part of this application will be stored in accordance with our Privacy Policy. For CA applicants, please also refer to our CA Privacy Notice.

Precision Medicine Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process or are limited in the ability or unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact Precision Medicine Group at myHR@precisionmedicinegrp.com.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Project Manager is the day-to-day coordination point for Project Argos delivery: scope, schedule, resources, risk, dependencies, and stakeholder communications, run through a two-week Agile sprint cadence. The Program Manager above this role owns longer-term planning and contract administration with the Contracting Officer's Representative (COR). You own tactical, day-to-day delivery.

Project Argos is an agentic AI proof of concept for the Office of the National Coordinator for Health IT (ONC). * 2+ years managing day-to-day delivery on a government contract: deliverable tracking, status reporting, RAID logs, and stakeholder communication.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Pharmacy Mergers & Acquisitions
jobs.description:
**It’s not just a job. It’s a mission.**

Altruix is a high-touch pharmacy dedicated to serving behavioral health and intellectual and developmental disability populations. Through our pharmacy expertise, and specialized packaging, we promote medication adherence and improve patient outcomes. Our services help clients take medications as prescribed while reducing administrative burden for providers. Altruix customers achieve measurable results, including 90% adherence rates and a 40% reduction in ER and hospital-related costs. Learn more at www.altruix.com.

Altruix is seeking a hands-on **Project Manager - Pharmacy Mergers & Acquisitions** to lead the execution of pharmacy acquisitions, integrations, De Novo builds, and relocations. This role translates approved growth opportunities into actionable project plans and drives execution from pre-close or initial planning through launch, stabilization, and transition to ongoing operations. The Project Manager coordinates cross-functional teams, maintains accountability for milestones and deliverables, identifies and escalates risks, and supports multiple concurrent projects while strengthening Altruix’s repeatable M&A and De Novo implementation processes.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Own integrated project plans, timelines, milestones, dependencies, budgets, and deliverables, ensuring clear ownership and accountability across workstreams
* Lead project kickoffs, workstream reviews, and readiness meetings; document decisions and drive timely resolution of action items, risks, and dependencies
* Maintain project dashboards, risk and issue tracking, and leadership reporting, clearly communicating status, decisions needed, and recovery plans
* Coordinate cross-functional work across Operations, Clinical and Quality, Legal and Compliance, Finance, HR, IT, Revenue Cycle, Payer, Licensing, Facilities, Procurement, Sales, Marketing, 340B, and Logistics

  

**M&A Integration:**

* Build and manage transaction-specific integration plans based on deal structure, locations, licensing, payer enrollment, workforce, systems, contracts, and operational requirements
* Coordinate seller information requests and pre-close planning in accordance with Legal-approved access and confidentiality requirements
* Drive Day 1 readiness and post-close integration through stabilization, coordinating employee onboarding, financial and billing continuity, procurement, technology, supplier transitions, communications, and operating workflows
* Coordinate system migrations, testing, cutover, contingency planning, and operational support to minimize disruption to patient and client service

  

**De Novo Builds and Pharmacy Relocations:**

* Translate approved opportunities into project scope, budgets, launch plans, timelines, and readiness requirements, escalating material changes to cost, timing, staffing, or scope
* Coordinate site selection, lease and facility activities, permitting, construction, licensing, equipment, technology, staffing, supplier setup, inventory, and operational readiness with functional owners and external partners
* Manage pharmacy relocations and Construction De Novo launches, ensuring licensing, payer, staffing, technology, patient transition, and operational dependencies are addressed before opening

  

**Launch Readiness and Continuous Improvement:**

* Coordinate functional readiness signoffs and escalate unresolved regulatory, patient-safety, payer, security, financial, or operational risks before launch
* Lead launch support, issue resolution, stabilization reviews, and formal handoff to ongoing Operations
* Monitor project performance against approved scope, schedule, budget, and operating objectives; capture lessons learned and continuously improve implementation playbooks and templates

  

**Success Metrics:**

* Success is demonstrated through reliable milestone delivery, clear cross-functional accountability, controlled scope and budget, launch readiness, continuity of patient and client service, effective issue resolution, and successful transition to ongoing operations

  

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, healthcare administration, project management, or related field, or equivalent relevant experience
* 5+ years of project management or implementation experience leading complex, cross-functional projects involving multiple departments, vendors, or locations
* Experience in healthcare, pharmacy operations, acquisitions/integrations, facility openings, or other regulated environments strongly preferred
* Strong planning, facilitation, communication, problem-solving, and follow-through skills with the ability to influence across functional teams
* Proficiency with Excel and project management tools, including schedules, dashboards, budgets, and action tracking

* PMP or equivalent certification preferred
* Behavioral health or long-term care pharmacy, pharmacy system conversions, construction coordination, and/or 340B experience preferred

  

**Travel Expectations:**

* Travel is required for site assessments, acquisition transitions, construction milestones, and pharmacy launches. Occasional work outside normal business hours may be required during critical transitions

  

**BENEFITS:**

* Salary of $115,000 to $125,000 based on experience
* Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, and Long-Term Disability
* 401(k) program
* Paid time off
* Paid holidays

jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

We are seeking a highly capable, organized, and proactive professional to work directly with an entrepreneur who owns and operates multiple businesses across different industries and locations throughout the United States.

Our business interests include insurance, tax services, technology, professional services, media, and other developing ventures.

As our portfolio continues to grow, we are looking for someone who can help establish organization, coordinate operations, manage projects, and ensure important business initiatives consistently move forward.

This position combines elements of executive assistance, business operations, project management, and strategic coordination.

**We are not looking for someone who simply waits for instructions. We need a resourceful individual who can take initiative, solve problems, follow through, and take meaningful responsibilities off the business owner's plate.**

**Multi-Business Operations**

* Help organize and coordinate operations across multiple companies.
* Establish centralized systems to track business activities, projects, and priorities.
* Ensure deadlines, deliverables, and business objectives are consistently followed up on.
* Assist with implementing processes that improve organization and efficiency.

* Track assignments and follow up with employees, contractors, and service providers.

* Help the founder remain focused on growth, strategy, and high-level business decisions.

**Team & Vendor Coordination**

* Communicate with employees, managers, freelancers, and outside service providers across different locations.
* Track assignments, deliverables, and deadlines.
* Assist with hiring, onboarding, and coordinating personnel.
* Hold team members accountable for progress and completion.
* Improve communication and workflow between different businesses.

**Business Growth & Implementation**

* Coordinate website, marketing, technology, and operational projects.
* Help implement new business systems, software, and automation.
* Assist with vendor comparisons, service sourcing, and other special projects.
* Help develop procedures that allow businesses to operate more independently.

Qualifications

Submit your resume along with a brief explanation of your experience supporting business owners, organizing multiple projects, or coordinating business operations.

jobs.title: Senior Air Operations Center (AOC) Operations & Technology Program Manager
jobs.description:
Position Summary:

Odyssey has an exciting opportunity for a **Senior** **AOC Operations & Technology** **Program Manager** providing support to the Command, Control, Communications (C3C)/Kessel Run division.

Kessel Run is revolutionizing how the United States Air Force develops, deploys, and operates mission-critical software. We are seeking an experienced AOC Operations & Technology Program Manager to serve as the critical bridge between commercial airline operations control practices and military Air Operations Center (AOC) modernization

This is a full time remote position.

**\*\* Position Contingent upon Contract Award\*\***

Responsibilities:

In this role, you will leverage deep commercial airline industry expertise—specifically from Airline Operations Control Centers (OCC / NOCC)—to advise and guide software product teams, operational leaders, and system architects. You will help translate battle-tested commercial concepts such as Collaborative Decision Making (CDM), real-time disruption management, automated flight dispatch, and predictive resource allocation into modern, cloud-native command and control (C2) software capabilities for the warfighter.

**Duties include, but not limited to:**

**Commercial Aviation Practices & Operational Strategy**

* Champion the adoption of proven commercial airline Operations Control Center (OCC) processes, metrics, and workflows across Air Operations Center functional areas.
* Introduce and adapt commercial Collaborative Decision Making (CDM) frameworks and Air Traffic Management (ATM) flow strategies to military airspace planning and dynamic air tasking.
* Advise leadership on modern disruption management (irregular operations / IROP) models, crew/fleet recovery algorithms, and slot management concepts to improve operational resilience and sortie execution.

**Product Roadmapping & Technology Modernization**

* Partner closely with product managers, software engineers, and user-experience (UX) designers to translate operational pain points into clear user stories, functional requirements, and product roadmaps.
* Facilitate user-centered design sessions and workflow mapping between operational controllers, planners, and software development teams within an agile/DevSecOps development cycle.
* Evaluate emerging commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) airline software, optimization solvers, and cloud architectures to determine feasibility for integration into modern AOC software suites.

**Operational Metrics & Performance Optimization**

* Establish and monitor data-driven operational KPIs modeled after commercial aviation standards (e.g., departure punctuality, turnaround time optimization, asset utilization, and fuel/route efficiency).
* Utilize operational telemetry and user feedback to identify planning bottlenecks, track system adoption, and quantify the operational impact of newly deployed software features.
* Oversee capacity planning and operational modeling to support both day-to-day operations and surge tasking requirements.

**Stakeholder Collaboration & Change Management**

* Serve as the primary operational liaison between software product teams, operational military leadership, acquisition authorities, and industry technology partners.
* Drive change management initiatives that help traditional operations teams transition smoothly from legacy monolithic software and paper-based tracking to automated, cloud-based applications.
* Prepare operational impact analyses, technical white papers, and business cases to justify modernization investments.

**\*\* Position Contingent upon Contract Award\*\***

Qualifications:

**Citizenship: Must be a US citizen**

***Minimum Required Qualifications***

**Clearance****:** Must be able to obtain a Secret Clearance

**Education:** Bachelor’s Degree in a related field in the respective technical/professional discipline being performed

**Years of experience:** 5+ years of operational management experience within a major commercial airline, air cargo carrier, or airline operations technology provider.

* **OCC / Dispatch Background:** Direct experience operating within or building technology for a commercial Network Operations Control Center (NOCC/OCC), Flight Dispatch, or Integrated Operations Center.
* **Aviation Domain Knowledge:** Comprehensive understanding of flight operations, dispatch workflows, slot and flow management, disruption recovery (IROP), and crew/aircraft schedule optimization.
* **Leadership & Change Management:** Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional teams, managing complex technical programs, and championing process change across operational workgroups.

**Compensation:** $105,000 - $120,000

**Reports to:** Director of VBC Operations

**Direct Reports:** VBC Operations Coordinators and Patient Engagement Representative

**Location:** Remote (with the ability for limited travel to facility partners and team meetings)

**About Vitae Health Systems:**

Founded in 2018, Vitae Health Systems is one of the largest providers of behavioral health, internal medicine, and podiatry services to residents of Skilled Nursing and Assisted Living Facilities. Headquartered in Chicago, IL, we currently operate in over 10 states and are rapidly expanding throughout the USA.

**Overview**

Vitae launches its ACO under the CMS Long-term Enhanced ACO Design (LEAD) Model on January 1, 2027, building on our experience in ACO REACH High Needs. The VBC Program Manager builds and runs the operating rhythm of the LEAD ACO, making sure the work that drives results (beneficiary alignment, utilization, quality performance, and program compliance) is tracked, scheduled, and followed through on time.

This is a hands-on operating role. You will lead the VBC operations team, run the weekly and monthly performance cadence with the VBC data resource, and work with the VBC clinical team and operations managers to turn performance data into clear, prioritized actions. You own the calendar, the cadence, and the follow-through. Clinical standards and compliance decisions remain with clinical and compliance leadership.

**Key Responsibilities**

**LEAD ACO Operating Cadence and Performance Tracking**

* Run the weekly team huddle and monthly performance review covering alignment, utilization, quality, and reported spend, using KPIs and targets set by VBC leadership.
* Track performance against the LEAD quality measures and Prevention and Quality Plan milestones, and report variances to leadership.
* Monitor utilization drivers (admissions, readmissions, ED visits, post-acute stays) and confirm high-risk patients have a named owner and documented action, escalating gaps to clinical leadership.
* Review operational CMS reports and data feeds monthly, flag variances early, and escalate risks with a recommended path.
* Maintain the master calendar of CMS deadlines and deliverables, with a named owner for each, and follow up so nothing is missed.

**Alignment and Compliance Oversight**

* Oversee the voluntary alignment program against leadership-set targets and deadlines, including a documented pre-submission review before each CMS submission.
* Oversee reconciliation of CMS alignment lists to census and EHR data, and lead root cause reviews on avoidable attrition (deaths, hospice elections, moves, Medicare Advantage enrollment).
* Reconcile Participant and Preferred Provider lists to HR and credentialing records at the TIN/NPI level, escalating any change that needs a leadership or Compliance decision.
* Verify that beneficiary notifications and outreach activities are completed, tracked, and documented to CMS requirements, in partnership with Compliance.

**Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Work with operations managers on how VBC activities are scheduled and delivered at the facility and NP level, surfacing barriers early and avoiding unnecessary burden.
* Partner with VBC clinical leadership so workflows, checklists, and handoffs reflect clinical standards.
* Support development of provider-facing materials (scorecards, tip sheets, trainings) with the clinical and data owners, coordinating timelines and operational input.

**Data, Reporting & Continuous Improvement**

* Submit and sequence reporting requests to the VBC data resource through a single intake, review data for reasonableness before use in reviews, and flag manual work that could be automated.
* Prepare the performance summaries the Director of VBC Operations presents to senior leadership and ACO governance, aggregating data, clinical, and operational input.
* Lead root cause reviews when measures move off target and turn findings into action plans with named owners and due dates, tracking each to closure and routing clinical actions to clinical leadership.
* Facilitate a quarterly improvement cycle (plan, do, study, act) based on financial and performance results, with the Director of VBC Operations as sponsor: convene Finance, clinical, and data partners to select opportunities, assign actions, evaluate results, and document learning in a VBC operating playbook.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead the VBC operations team and serve as its first point of contact: coach, set priorities and escalation thresholds, build SOPs with process owners, and resolve operational questions and blockers within defined boundaries, escalating strategic, financial, compliance, and policy matters to the Director of VBC Operations.
* Provide input to the Director of VBC Operations on structure and staffing as scope grows.

**What Success Looks Like**

* **First 90 days**: The master CMS calendar is in place with named owners. The weekly and monthly cadence is running and escalation thresholds are defined. The first quarterly improvement cycle is launched, with opportunities, owners, measures, and evaluation dates set. Team members have clear goals and documented workflows.
* **First year**: Two or more improvement cycles are completed with documented results and feed a VBC operating playbook. Alignment, quality, and utilization are tracked against targets all year, with action plans when a measure is off target. Escalations arrive with context and a recommended path.

 **Requirements**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, public health, business, nursing, or a related field
* 4+ years in value-based care, ACO operations, or population health (provider-side strongly preferred)
* Direct experience in a CMS ACO model (ACO REACH, especially High Needs, MSSP, or LEAD)
* Experience in post-acute, SNF, or long-term care
* 2+ years managing staff
* Track record running recurring operating cadences and hitting deadlines

OU Education Services is seeking a Technical Project Manager, Enterprise Systems & Integrations to lead delivery of complex enterprise technology initiatives across our growing online education ecosystem, spanning CRM implementation, system integrations, data lake and data platforms, migration, automation, and AI solutions.

This is a hands-on role that works deeply across both the technical and operational sides of delivery. Systems & Integration

Required

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, PMO
jobs.description:

As a Senior Project Manager at U.S. Renal Care, you will lead complex business and technology initiatives from initiation through implementation. This role is responsible for driving project execution, facilitating cross-functional collaboration, managing risks and dependencies, and ensuring successful delivery of strategic outcomes. The Senior Project Manager serves as a trusted partner to business leaders, technology teams, and vendors by providing leadership, governance, and communication throughout the project lifecycle.

Successful candidates are proactive, adaptable, solution-oriented, and skilled at navigating complex organizational environments while maintaining focus on delivery, quality, and business value.

At U.S. Renal Care, your work has purpose, colleagues care about your well-being, and you have the opportunity to grow and thrive.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

Other duties and responsibilities may be assigned.

* Manage multiple concurrent projects from concept through completion using Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery approaches while maintaining accountability for project outcomes, timelines, quality, and business value.
* Lead cross-functional project teams comprised of business stakeholders, technical resources, third-party vendors, consultants, and contracted resources.
* Develop and execute project plans, delivery roadmaps, budgets, resource plans, and governance strategies aligned to business objectives.
* Facilitate project planning activities including scope definition, requirements review, schedule development, resource coordination, and dependency management.
* Provide clear, concise, and executive-level communication regarding project status, risks, issues, dependencies, key decisions, and recommendations.
* Proactively identify, manage, and elevate project risks, issues, decisions, and dependencies to ensure timely resolution and minimize impacts to scope, schedule, budget, and quality.
* Drive project outcomes by removing impediments, facilitating decision-making, and promoting accountability across project teams.
* Develop communication and stakeholder engagement plans and facilitate project meetings, working sessions, and Steering Committee meetings.
* Apply Agile principles and practices as appropriate, facilitating team ceremonies and planning activities to promote efficient delivery and continuous improvement.
* Ensure adherence to PMO methodologies, governance standards, reporting requirements, and project management best practices.
* Manage project change requests, implementation planning, deployment activities, and post-implementation support coordination.
* Manage relationships with third-party vendors and implementation partners to ensure delivery commitments and contractual obligations are met.
* Lead organizational readiness activities and partner with stakeholders to support adoption of project deliverables.
* Conduct post-project reviews and facilitate Lessons Learned sessions to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Foster collaboration, transparency, and accountability across project teams and stakeholders.
* Actively promote GUEST customer service standards and develop effective working relationships at all levels of the organization.
* Regular and reliable attendance is required.

**Qualifications / Requirements**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential function satisfactorily.

*Education*

* Bachelor's degree required.

*Experience*

* 7+ years of project management experience leading cross-functional business and technology initiatives.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent projects with varying levels of complexity and organizational impact.
* Experience working in Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery environments.
* Healthcare experience preferred but not required.
* Experience leading vendor-supported implementations and managing external delivery partners preferred.

*Certifications*

* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification preferred.
* Agile certification such as Certified Scrum Master (CSM), PMI-ACP, SAFe, or equivalent preferred.

*Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities*

* Strong leadership, facilitation, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills.
* Demonstrated ability to influence and drive results without direct authority.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
* Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate effectively at all levels of the organization, including executive leadership.
* Ability to translate complex technical information into business-friendly language.
* Experience managing stakeholder expectations and organizational change.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize competing demands in a fast-paced environment.

RISCPoint was founded with the vision to seamlessly integrate with your team, utilizing only high-performing professionals with deep technical and operational experience to fulfill your security and compliance needs.

This role includes proactively identifying, analyzing, and responding to security events and incidents, performing regular vulnerability assessments and remediation tracking, and ensuring system configurations, controls, and documentation remain aligned with FedRAMP, NIST, and organizational security requirements. * Maintain Plan of Action & Milestones (POA&M) documentation

* Tune security tools to reduce false positives
* Develop custom detection rules and alerts
* Create security dashboards and reports

* Experience with vulnerability management and remediation
* Hands-on experience with SIEM platforms and security monitoring tools
* Experience analyzing security logs and investigating incidents

* One of: ISC2 CISSP/CCSP, GIAC GCIH (Preferred)

* IDS/IPS: Suricata, Zeek, Snort
* Cloud Security: AWS GuardDuty, AWS Security Hub, CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs, AWS IAM
* Endpoint Security: CrowdStrike, Carbon Black, Microsoft Defender

* Scripting, Automation, IaC: Python, Ansible, AWS CLI, Terraform

* Company Paid Health Insurance

* Generous Vacation Policy

jobs.title: Program Manager, Medical Communications
jobs.description:
Are you a highly organized project management professional who thrives in a fast-paced client services environment? Precision AQ is seeking a Program Manager to play a critical leadership role in the successful delivery of medical communications programs. In this position, you will partner closely with Scientific Directors, Strategic Account leaders, clients, and cross-functional teams to drive project execution, maintain operational excellence, and ensure timely delivery of high-quality work. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys balancing client partnership, process management, financial oversight, and team collaboration while contributing to impactful healthcare communications programs.

### **About You**

* You are a highly organized project manager who can successfully oversee multiple projects, stakeholders, timelines, and priorities simultaneously.
* You are a proactive problem solver who anticipates challenges, identifies risks early, and develops effective solutions.
* You excel at building relationships and communicating clearly with clients, vendors, and internal teams.
* You enjoy working in a collaborative environment and serving as a key operational leader across complex programs.
* You have a strong attention to detail and take pride in maintaining accurate project documentation, financial tracking, and workflow processes.
* You are comfortable providing guidance and mentorship to junior team members while supporting their professional growth.

### **About the Role**

As one of the three core leaders of the account team, the Program Manager is responsible for developing, managing, and communicating project workflows that ensure successful execution of client programs. You will serve as a vital operational partner to Scientific Directors and Strategic Account Directors/Managers, providing visibility into timelines, milestones, resource needs, financial performance, and project status.

In this role, you will oversee project workflows, coordinate medical/legal/regulatory (MLR) review processes, manage project documentation, and support financial tracking and invoicing activities. You will act as a primary client contact for project status updates, operational discussions, and financial communications while ensuring compliance with relevant client and industry requirements. Additionally, you may manage program logistics, coordinate vendor activities, and provide guidance and support to Program Coordinators.

### **Required Experience**

* Bachelor's degree required.
* 1–3 years of project management experience within a pharmaceutical-related service business such as medical communications, healthcare advertising, sales training, or digital production.
* Demonstrated experience managing multiple projects, timelines, stakeholders, and deliverables in a deadline-driven environment.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with clients and cross-functional teams.
* Experience supporting project budgets, financial monitoring, invoicing, or resource planning activities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and project management tools.
* Ability and willingness to travel as required.

### **Helpful Experience**

* Experience managing Medical, Legal, and Regulatory (MLR) review processes.
* Knowledge of scientific publication planning processes and Datavision.
* Experience working with vendors, meeting logistics, or event planning activities.
* Previous experience coaching, training, or mentoring junior project management professionals.

### **Who We Are**

Precision AQ - Medical Communications was founded with the simple belief that the scientific story is the foundation of every pharmaceutical brand. Our teams of inquisitive problem solvers and passionate creators dig deep to translate the science behind today's cutting-edge therapies, then communicate the science clearly and credibly. Our proven track record of long-tenured relationships with major pharmaceutical companies and leading bio-tech firms, and our inclusive, open-minded team culture are industry leading. This passionate work environment, paired with growth opportunity, professional development, compensation, and benefits, are why Precision AQ - Medical Communications was recognized as a Best Place to Work by the Philadelphia Business Journal for the last three years.

Are you ready to join a team committed to providing the best in science and strategy?

jobs.description:
In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for a project manager who will be responsible for leading enterprise software implementation and technology transformation projects across a client organization, with an initial focus on the implementation of a Human Resources Information System (HRIS). This role manages the full project lifecycle, including planning, requirements gathering, vendor coordination, system implementation, data migration, testing, training, organizational change management, deployment, and post-implementation support.

  
  

The successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, Information Technology, vendors, consultants, and executive leadership to deliver technology solutions that improve operational efficiency, data quality, user experience, and business performance. While the initial assignment will focus on the HRIS implementation, the role may lead additional enterprise software implementations and business transformation projects as organizational priorities evolve.

  
  

This is a client-facing technical role, and does not support development or implementation of internal facing Parsons IT systems.

jobs.title: Culinary and Recipe Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**Why Epicured?**

Epicured is on a mission to combat and prevent chronic disease, translating scientific research into high-quality food products for patients nationwide. Our evidence-based approach brings the best of the clinical and culinary worlds together to help people eat better, feel better, and live better one meal at a time.

**About Epicured**

Epicured helps prevent and manage chronic disease through medically tailored nutrition, combining clinical research with culinary expertise to improve health outcomes nationwide. Join a mission-driven team working at the intersection of food, healthcare, and technology.

By joining our team, you’ll contribute to meaningful initiatives at the intersection of food, healthcare, and technology — helping to improve access, reduce complexity, and directly impact the lives of people managing chronic health conditions.

**Position Overview**

Epicured is seeking a Culinary & Recipe Data Analyst to serve as a system manager and technical backbone for our recipe database in Galley. In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end input, audit, and management of recipe data across all of our business lines.

Working directly with our Culinary Product Manager, you will follow established SOPs to ensure that every dish—from raw ingredient sourcing and vendor mapping to nutrition profiles and clinical allergen tags—is accurately modeled in Galley.

This is a critical role that directly unblocks our culinary backlog and optimizes product development. You will protect the integrity of our database architecture, support our cross-functional workflows, and have room to grow into broader product and data analysis responsibilities within the department.

**Responsibilities**

* Recipe Data Management - input, standardize, and maintain detailed recipe specifications across all business lines within the Galley platform according to company SOPs.
* Ingredient & Vendor Architecture - onboard and manage ingredients, map vendor supply data, and link accurate nutritional definitions and unit conversions.
* Attribute & Tagging Governance - apply and audit clinical, dietary, and operational attributes (e.g., Low FODMAP, Diabetes-Friendly, Cardiovascular, Active, Inactive) at both the sub-recipe and completed dish level to protect system integrity.
* Cross-Functional Data Quality - partner with culinary, clinical, and operation teams to audit existing recipes, correct discrepancies, and perform regular quality assurance checks on menu data.
* Process & System Support - identify operational bottlenecks in recipe data entry, assist in refining SOPs, and ensure data consistency to support downstream menu planning and rotation, nutrition review, and labeling outputs.

**Qualifications**

* Industry Experience: 2-3 years of food industry experience; whether through commercial kitchen/culinary experience, a background in food regulation, or work as a Registered Dietitian.
* Education: a degree in Food Science (preferred)
* Systems / Data Literacy: Proficiency in database entry or food management platforms (Galley experience is a huge plus, but other system experience is welcome).
* Eager to learn, adapt, and scale responsibilities within culinary operations / product development within the organization.
* Technical / Analytical Skills: Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets for data manipulation, cross-referencing, and basic analysis.
* Meticulous approach to data integrity, numbers, unit conversions (yields, serving sizes, weights), and technical ingredient and recipe specifications

**Compensation & Benefits**

Pay: $70,000 - $85,000/year, based on experience

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Employee meal discounts

* Epicured is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of age, race, creed, color, national origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under federal, state, or local law.

**How to Apply**

* Apply through the job board. Questions may be directed to careers@getepicured.com.

AI Operations | Managed AI Services | Full-Time, Exempt
  
ECI is seeking an AI Operations Analyst to serve as the operational front door for AI across its client base. This role helps clients adopt, operate, govern, and expand their use of approved enterprise AI platforms while ensuring each request is connected to the right technical guidance, governance path, and service engagement.
  
  
About ECI
  
ECI is building a dedicated AI Operations capability to help regulated organizations operate AI successfully and responsibly at scale. The AI Operations Analyst will work alongside engineers, governance specialists, adoption consultants, business development, and client-facing teams while helping shape ECI's managed AI operations discipline.
  
Position Summary
  
The AI Operations Analyst owns AI-related requests from intake through outcome confirmation, coordinating work across internal teams and maintaining clear client communication. The role combines technical support, client advisory, use-case discovery, governance awareness, and service coordination. Success requires understanding the business need behind each request, translating technical concepts into practical guidance, and engaging the appropriate specialists when broader value or deeper expertise is required.
  
Key Responsibilities
  

* Serve as the primary intake point for AI-related incidents, requests, advisory questions, changes, and operational needs, maintaining ownership through confirmed resolution or outcome.
* Classify, prioritize, document, and coordinate work through established service-management processes and provide proactive communication to clients and internal stakeholders.
* Provide operational support for Microsoft 365 Copilot, Anthropic Claude Enterprise, OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise, Copilot Studio, approved agents and connectors, and future approved AI platforms.
* Support licensing, entitlements, user access, group membership, troubleshooting, configuration validation, feature guidance, prompt assistance, and agent triage.
* Determine when a request can be resolved through a standard procedure and when AI Engineering, Security Operations, Infrastructure, AI Deployment, AI Adoption, AI Governance, or another specialist team should be engaged.
* Engage clients to understand the business objective behind technical requests and connect needs to relevant AI use cases, productivity goals, adoption requirements, and operational outcomes.
* Provide guidance on documented platform capabilities, limitations, and best practices, and participate in discovery discussions when technical context is needed.
* Recognize opportunities for AI Adoption, AI Governance, AI Engineering, AI Deployment, managed AI services, or related project work, and introduce the appropriate ECI leader or delivery specialist.
* Identify data protection, responsible AI, security, compliance, shadow AI, prompt-injection, and data-exposure concerns and route them through the correct escalation process.
* Maintain knowledge articles, runbooks, and standard operating procedures; track recurring support patterns and release impacts; and recommend automation, self-service, and service improvements.

Required Qualifications
  

* Three to seven years of experience in technical account management, customer success engineering, managed services operations, solutions engineering, Microsoft 365 administration, IT service delivery, SaaS support, or enterprise technical support.
* Demonstrated success in a client-facing technical role and experience using an IT service-management platform such as ServiceNow.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, including Copilot, Teams, SharePoint Online, Exchange Online, and Microsoft Entra ID.
* Familiarity with enterprise AI platforms, SaaS administration, licensing, single sign-on, SCIM, conditional access, and ITIL service-management concepts.
* Foundational understanding of AI governance, responsible AI, data protection, security, and operational risk.
* Ability to translate technical concepts into business language, uncover requirements through discovery conversations, and coordinate effectively across technical and client-facing teams.
* Excellent written communication, documentation, analytical, escalation-management, and knowledge-authoring skills.

Preferred Qualifications
  

* Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert (MS-102), Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900), or ITIL 4 Foundation certification.
* Experience with Claude Enterprise, ChatGPT Enterprise, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Purview, Defender for Cloud Apps, or Microsoft Power Platform.

* Experience supporting financial services or another regulated industry.

ECI’s culture is all about connection - connection with our clients, our technology and most importantly with each other. In addition to working with an amazing team around the world, ECI also offers a competitive compensation package and the base salary for this role is $125,000 plus flexible PTO, health benefit eligibility the first of the month, life insurance, pet insurance, 401K and so much more! Love Your Job, Share Your Technology Passion, Create Your Future Here!
  
ECI is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration consistent with applicable law.

**Our Unique** **Work:**

* Bachelor's degree in a related field

The Maryland Department of Juvenile Services (DJS) is dedicated to transforming young lives, creating safer communities, and fostering equitable systems. The **Security and Privacy Officer** serves as the dedicated cybersecurity and privacy lead for DJS. The role functions as DJS’s empowered Information Security Officer and designated Agency Privacy Officer (APO), ensuring the department meets its cybersecurity and privacy obligations distinct from the Office of Security Management’s (OSM) statewide mandate. *In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute in various ways, including:*

ANDECO is building a data platform for a federal customer. A subcontractor will do most of the engineering. ANDECO owns the program, accepts the deliverables, and maintains the platform after delivery. The Technical Project Manager makes sure the right work gets done on schedule. You will sit between ANDECO leadership and the subcontractor's engineers, track execution against milestones, test reported progress against working software, and keep leadership informed.

The initial requirements and milestones are already defined, so your early focus is execution: keeping the subcontractor on plan and catching problems early. As the platform matures, you will take a larger role in its design, writing user stories and building requirements for later phases. This is a technical role. You need enough depth to question engineering decisions, and the judgment to turn that detail into short assessments that nontechnical leaders can act on.

**Manage delivery against the plan**

* Track subcontractor work against the approved project plan, milestones, deliverables, and demonstration schedule, and hold the subcontractor to them.
* Maintain the schedule, risk register, and decision log. Catch schedule and cost slips early and bring leadership options before a problem becomes a surprise.
* Run change control so that changes to requirements, architecture, schedule, cost, or deliverables are surfaced, priced, and approved before work proceeds.
* Own the acceptance test plan. Define the tests and demonstrations each milestone must pass, run or witness them, and recommend acceptance or rejection to ANDECO leadership.
* Confirm that source code, build instructions, infrastructure code, and documentation are deposited with ANDECO at each milestone, and that they are complete enough for another team to build and run the platform.
* Keep a productive working relationship with the subcontractor while holding it to ANDECO's requirements.
* Make sure ANDECO receives the documentation, tests, and handoff materials it needs to maintain the platform after delivery.

**Evaluate technical work**

* Take part in architecture discussions, design reviews, demonstrations, and sprint reviews.
* Test reported progress against working software, test results, and documentation, and challenge estimates and technical approaches the evidence does not support.
* Judge whether the implementation meets approved requirements and security constraints, and flag integration problems and deployment blockers.
* Make sure changes to the data model and ontology are reviewed and approved by ANDECO before the subcontractor builds on them.
* Make sure testing, documentation, and security get attention alongside feature completion.

**Shape requirements as the platform evolves**

* Write user stories and acceptance criteria, and keep requirements traceable to deliverables, testing, and acceptance.
* Prioritize the backlog with ANDECO leadership and engineers.
* Contribute to design decisions and later phase requirements as the project moves beyond its initial plan.

**Brief Leadership**

* Give senior executives short assessments of progress, risk, cost, schedule, and subcontractor performance, along with the decisions coming due.
* Translate technical issues into business and program consequences for nontechnical decision makers.
* Create the dashboards and slide decks that executives rely on to make decisions.
* Distinguish completed, tested work from work still in progress.

**Coordinate across teams**

* Serve as the coordination point among ANDECO leadership, engineers, analysts, government sponsors, and the subcontractor.

* Follow ANDECO processes and recommend improvements where they would help.
* Use ANDECO provided AI tools in your daily work and help the team put them to use.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience overseeing subcontractors, vendors, or other external engineering teams.

* Ability to explain complex technical issues to senior leaders and nontechnical stakeholders, in writing and in person.
* Experience using AI tools in professional work, and willingness to adopt ANDECO provided AI tools.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or Business Administration.
* *U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance.*

**Preferred Qualifications**

jobs.title: Engagement and Program Manager - Wealth / Asset Management
jobs.description:
*Please do not contact us or apply if you are a recruiter, consultant or outsourcing company.*

**Deliver with focus. Scale with intent**

Are you a delivery leader who knows how to guide large customers through complex set-ups without over-engineering the journey? Do you care deeply about building scalable, repeatable SaaS delivery rather than one-off custom projects?  
  
At Performativ, we’re building the infrastructure layer for modern wealth management. As our Engagement and Program Manager, you’ll lead the rollout of our SaaS platform for our largest customers, successfully onboarding them through structured delivery, clear communication, and lightweight technical engagement.  
  
This is not a professional services consulting role. You won’t be buried in endless customer-specific code or heavy customizations. Instead, you’ll work cross-functionally to help customers adopt our product the right way: cleanly, securely, and in line with platform best practices so they can scale on top of us, not around us.

**What you will do**

* Own enterprise set-up programs end to end (kick-off through to go-live and hyper-care) against an agreed plan and scope (Statement of Work).
* Interrogate and determine how customer requirements are and describe how they can be addressed in the platform.
* Enable customers to integrate Performativ via standard platform patterns (APIs, SSO, configuration) without custom buildouts, working with product and engineering to flag gaps early and advocate for scalable paths.
* Own plan, scope, and change control, keeping scope tied to contract and change visible and decided rather than quietly absorbed, and support the Technical Program Lead on requirements, design documents, and acceptance-criteria sign-off.
* Run customer communication, cadence, and governance with reporting that keeps meetings short, and manage risk, dependency, and issue tracking (including customer-side).
* Lead a clean handover to Customer Success at go-live or hyper-care exit, including train-the-trainer sessions and supporting materials.
* Represent the program in internal capacity and exception reviews, bringing requests the plan cannot absorb back as options rather than committing on the spot.
* Build repeatable playbooks, documentation, and artefacts that make the next program faster. You will be measured on this, not only on your own delivery.

**How you will work**

You will run multiple programs at once, in a delivery pod alongside the Technical Program Lead, Integration Engineers, Data Migration Specialists, and Product Engineers. None report to you. Rather you get things done through clarity and relationships, not authority. You will report to the COO. The role is remote with travel 40% of the time – both to customer site and to our head-office in Copenhagen - expected as a minimum.

**What we're looking for**

* 7+ years in program or engagement management, consulting, product management, or another delivery-facing role, with a track record of leading complex, multi-stakeholder implementations end to end.
* Experience in either wealth management, private banking and / or asset management is a pre-requisite experience.
* Comfortable being firm with customers on scope and timeline while keeping the relationship stronger for it.
* Structured and highly organized, producing written plans, governance cadences, and reporting that stakeholders can act on.
* Broad technical literacy across enterprise SaaS delivery: API-based integrations, SSO and security configuration, and data migration and mapping, including enough SQL to read and question a mapping. You do not build the integration, but you understand it well enough to scope it, question it, and know when something does not add up.
* Ability to build working fluency in the customer's business domain fast: within 90 days, able to discuss topics such as advice and suitability workflows and customer reporting without a subject-matter expert in the room.
* ITIL Foundation, PMP, PRINCE2 Certification (or equivalent) would be beneficial but not required.

**Technical Fluency**

* You’re not, necessarily, a developer, but you’re comfortable with APIs, data structures, auth flows (OAuth/SAML), and deployment models.
* You can dive into logs, payloads, and basic SQL or Python when needed to unblock yourself or a customer - but you prioritize scalable fixes over tactical workarounds.
* You advocate for platform-aligned solutions, not special cases.

**What this role is not**

This role sits in operations, not engineering or commercial, and is project-based: once delivery is complete, you roll on to the next engagement. As a SaaS provider, we do not build bespoke software; delivery works within the bounds of the product.

**We can offer :**

* Trust and responsibility to shape how Performativ delivers for its largest customers.
* A competitive salary and benefits package.
* A fast-growing, VC-backed fintech scaleup, working alongside professionals from leading institutions (Goldman Sachs, McKinsey, BCG, Amazon and others).
* Career acceleration through professional development and leadership opportunities.
