jobs.description:
**About Profitero+**

Profitero+ is the leading digital commerce company, trusted by more than 4,000 brands worldwide. We help brands break down silos and turn data into decisive action through intelligence-driven, end-to-end solutions that unify media, content, operations and strategy. Powered by advanced *AI*, robust *digital shelf* analytics across *1,400+ retailers in 70 countries* and unmatched expertise from digital commerce specialists in *15 global hubs*, our integrated solutions help brands accelerate profitable growth.

  

Come and be a part of our fast-paced, entrepreneurial culture and next stage of growth.

  

**Location:** Hybrid role based in Reading once per month & London 3 times per month

  

**Overview**

As a Data Analyst, you will play a key role in transforming complex e-commerce data into reliable, intuitive analytical solutions that help our customers make better decisions. You will build and enhance client-facing dashboards, develop the data processes that support them, and work closely with clients and internal stakeholders to translate business questions into clear technical requirements and effective solutions.

  

This is a hands-on role combining advanced SQL, data modelling, dashboard development and client collaboration. You will take ownership of high-quality analytical delivery, identify opportunities to improve our products and ways of working, and support the development of junior team members. You will also help the team apply emerging AI and machine-learning technologies responsibly, ensuring outputs are accurate, robust and ready for use in production. This is an excellent opportunity to make a visible impact within a fast-paced, global SaaS company at the forefront of digital commerce.

  

**Profile**

You will be an experienced analyst with a strong background in direct-to-consumer analytics and the confidence to work across both technical and client-facing activities. You will combine advanced SQL and BI expertise with hands-on experience building, testing and maintaining transformation workflows and reusable data models in dbt, supported by a practical understanding of modern cloud data platforms and Python. You will be confident using Git and GitHub for version control, including working with branches, reviewing pull requests and collaborating safely on production code. Comfortable taking ownership in a fast-paced environment, you will be able to move from ambiguous business questions to well-scoped analytical solutions, communicate complex concepts clearly to non-technical audiences, and critically review data, code and AI-generated outputs before they reach production. You will also be collaborative, curious and proactive, with a genuine interest in mentoring others and developing new approaches that create measurable value for customers.

**Responsibilities:**

* Build, maintain and enhance dashboards in Sigma, ensuring they are accurate, intuitive and aligned with client and business requirements.
* Design and maintain ETL processes for a range of client data, optimising back-end data structures to ensure dashboards are reliable and performant. This will primarily involve Snowflake SQL, alongside a working knowledge of Python and experience with dbt workflows.
* Use Git and GitHub to manage version control across analytics code and data transformation projects, following collaborative development practices such as branching, pull requests, code reviews and clear documentation.
* Adhere to team processes and delivery standards, including using Jira to manage work and record time accurately.
* Partner directly with clients and internal stakeholders to gather and clarify technical requirements, translate business questions into analytical solutions, and recommend the most effective approach.
* Mentor junior team members, providing technical guidance, constructive feedback and support with problem-solving.
* Develop deep expertise in Profitero+’s industry, technology, products and data offerings, with a strong understanding of how related technologies address customers’ business challenges.
* Research and help develop new product and analytical offerings in response to client needs, market developments and emerging technologies, including AI- and machine-learning-based solutions.

  

**Qualified candidates will possess:**

* 3+ years’ experience in an analytics role.
* Advanced SQL skills, with experience working in a modern cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake or GBQ and using a data transformation and modelling tool such as dbt.
* The ability to review code written by others and identify logic or data-quality issues before they reach production dashboards, and have sufficient SQL and Python expertise to read, debug and extend existing scripts.
* Hands-on experience building dashboards and analytical solutions in BI platforms such as Sigma, Looker, Power BI or similar.
* Practical, day-to-day experience using AI-assisted coding and analysis tools, such as Claude Code, Cortex or Coco. Write clear specifications for AI agents and critically review their outputs for accuracy, quality and suitability before release.

The Community Safety Crisis and Incident Response Through Community-Led Engagement (C.I.R.C.L.E.) program is a 24/7 unarmed response program that deploys a team of mental health professionals and individuals with lived experience to address non-violent LAPD calls related to unhoused individuals experiencing crisis. The goals of the program are to: (1) disrupt the reciprocal relationship between homelessness and the criminal justice system by promptly responding to diverted non-violent incidents related to persons experiencing homelessness (PEH); (2) de-escalate and stabilize incidents involving unhoused individuals; and (3) create enduring positive outcomes for those individuals through trauma informed rapport building, connections to services and resources, and case management.

**Poste et missions**
---------------------

  
  

Vous rejoindrez notre équipe Oversight, Quality & Controls , composée de 8 personnes, au sein du département Global Markets Operations, qui recherche un **Data Analyst** pour un stage de **6 mois** à partir de **novembre 2026.** Le secteur OQC est des secteurs du département Global Markets Operations, qui regroupe les activités post-marchés (Trade support, middle et back office). * Documenter et remonter de potentiels problèmes de qualité ;
* Proposer et suivre des plans de remédiation ;
* Participer à l’acculturation des parties prenantes.

**Description de l'entreprise**

*Veolia, leader mondial des services à l’environnement, participe chaque jour à construire la sécurité environnementale. Présent sur les cinq continents, le groupe dépollue, décarbone et régénère les ressources à travers des solutions concrètes combinant ses expertises dans le domaine de l’eau, des déchets et de l'énergie.*

*Partenaire de nombreux industriels et collectivités, l'Activité Recyclage & Valorisation, entité du groupe Veolia, a pour ambition de devenir le producteur de ressources renouvelables de référence en France. Nous proposons une gamme complète de solutions innovantes à toutes les étapes du cycle des déchets, de leur collecte à leur transformation et valorisation en matière et en énergie, grâce aux étapes de tri et de traitement.*

**VOTRE MISSION**

Rattachée à la Direction Direction Services aux Entreprises, au sein de la filière Commerce, Valorisation et Innovation, l’équipe développe de nouvelles offres B2B pour accompagner les entreprises dans leur transition vers l’économie circulaire.

Acteur de référence de la gestion et de la valorisation des déchets, la DSE évolue dans un marché en pleine transformation, marqué par les évolutions réglementaires, la montée en puissance de l’économie circulaire, la consolidation du secteur et l’évolution des attentes des clients. Pour éclairer ses décisions et soutenir sa conquête de nouvelles parts de marché, l’entreprise crée une équipe Market Intelligence.

* Définir la vision, le périmètre et la feuille de route; recruter, encadrer et faire monter en compétences les deux analystes;

* Coordonner les demandes des parties prenantes internes.

**Réaliser des études sectorielles et de marché :**

* Analyser les marchés de la collecte, du tri, du traitement et de la valorisation;
* Etudier les différentes typologies de déchets, filières et zones géographiques;
* Evaluer le potentiel de nouveaux marchés et anticiper les évolutions réglementaires, technologiques et économiques.

* Identifier et prioriser les cibles, analyser les appels d’offres et les renouvellements de contrats,
* Elaborer des plans de conquête avec les directions commerciales et fournir des analyses de comptes stratégiques.

**Communiquer et influencer :**

* Présenter les analyses et recommandations à la direction générale et aux comités de direction;
* Adapter les livrables aux besoins des publics et agir comme partenaire stratégique des directions métiers.

* **Culture commerciale et data :** bonne compréhension des enjeux commerciaux B2B, notamment des appels d’offres et des cycles de vente longs; maîtrise d’Excel avancé et d’outils de visualisation tels que Power BI ou équivalent. Des notions de CRM sont appréciées.
* **Connaissance sectorielle :** une expérience dans les déchets, l’environnement, l’énergie ou les utilities est un atout, mais l’expertise méthodologique prime.
* **Qualités personnelles :** leadership pragmatique, rigueur intellectuelle, esprit critique, orientation résultats, curiosité, autonomie et capacité à travailler en transversalité avec diplomatie.
* **Communication :** excellente capacité de synthèse à l’écrit comme à l’oral, avec une réelle aisance pour convaincre.
* **Langues :** anglais professionnel.

  
**Informations supplémentaires**

**Localisation :** Aubervilliers (périmètre national)

**Type de contrat :** CDI – création de poste

**Expérience** : 8 à 10 ans en market intelligence, études de marché, conseil en stratégie ou stratégie d’entreprise; une première expérience en management d’équipe ou en encadrement de projet est indispensable

jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the Role**
------------------

We are hiring a Technical Program Manager to lead high priority safety and security programs which advance defense in depth for agents, which we have written about publicly.

You will be the lead TPM coordinating work across teams to strengthen how we develop and deploy agents safely and securely, and to bring what we build internally to customers and partners so everyone has the tools to safely and securely use Claude. You will be responsible for leading meetings with executives and technical leads, maintaining complex project plans, identifying and addressing risks, developing metrics, and communicating to the company and our customers about this work.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* **Maintain the roadmap** - Maintain and extend the existing roadmap for all work contributing to this effort across the company and implement approaches to ensure accuracy and relevance amidst a fast operational tempo.
* **Turn program goals into measurable exit criteria at each phase of the work** - To do this well you’ll need to be responsive to new developments in capabilities and the threat landscape, both of which are evolving fast. Maintain key metrics and dashboards.
* **Run the operating rhythm** - Chair the leads meetings, working group meetings, design reviews, and executive check-ins. Record decisions and actions, disseminate sitreps quickly and regularly, and follow up until open issues close.
* **Lead executive and contributor communication** - Drive conversations, write regular reports, contribute to design documents, and produce decisional documents as needed. Say plainly what is on track, what is not, and where help is needed.
* **Maintain the risk register** - Track risks, exceptions, and risk acceptances in one place and bring hard calls to the right decision maker.
* **Drive company-wide communications** - Partner with internal communications on progress updates and on rollouts that change how employees work with Claude every day.
* **Lead through other TPMs** - Coordinate subject matter specific TPMs and engineering managers who do not report to you. Set shared standards, spot coverage gaps, and step in to augment capacity where needed.
* **Take coordination load off technical leaders** - Find owners for cross-team problems, frame tradeoffs across Security, Safeguards, Research, Privacy, Legal, and Product, manage staffing tasks, and organize exercises that test our controls.
* **Maintain industry context** - Track relevant incidents, capabilities shifts, and research across frontier labs, and understand the key risks they reveal. Bring those lessons into our threat model, roadmap, and risk register.

**You may be a good fit if you:**
---------------------------------

* Have led company-wide technical programs, especially a company-wide security program, with multiple workstreams, executive sponsors, and other program managers rolling up to you.
* Have a strong background in at least one of the program's domains: agent or infrastructure security, ML classifiers and monitoring, evaluations, inference infrastructure, protecting an organization’s most sensitive data, or shipping security controls to customers. You know the terminology and can ramp up on the rest quickly.
* Have worked closely with ML research teams and understand how models are trained and evaluated.
* Work independently. You set direction without waiting for instructions and know when to make decisions and when to escalate.
* Can command a room and hold senior engineers, researchers, and executives accountable without formal authority.
* Write clearly and fast for any audience, from a one-page executive brief to a company-wide announcement.
* Use AI tools like Claude to automate tracking, reporting, and follow-up.
* Care about AI safety and want to help keep powerful systems under human oversight.

* Have 10+ years of experience in one of the aforementioned areas.

**Annual Salary:** TBD with Recruiting.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

$365,000 - $435,000 USD

**Logistics**
-------------

**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
**JOB SUMMARY**

The Cybersecurity Operations Analyst is responsible for supporting and advancing THINK Surgical's cybersecurity program through a combination of security operations, incident response, vulnerability management, cybersecurity projects, compliance activities, AI governance initiatives, and data governance programs.

This role serves as a key contributor to the organization's overall cybersecurity and information protection strategy, helping secure systems, cloud services, endpoints, data, and emerging technologies while continuously improving cybersecurity maturity across the organization.

Approximately 60% of the role is focused on cybersecurity operations, vulnerability management, incident response, compliance support, and security administration. Approximately 40% of the role is focused on cybersecurity projects, AI governance, data governance initiatives, and continuous security improvement efforts.

The successful candidate will investigate security events, coordinate remediation efforts, support data protection initiatives, contribute to AI governance activities, and lead security improvement projects in collaboration with IT, Engineering, Quality, Compliance, and business stakeholders. This position is based at THINK’s corporate office.

**DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

Security Operations & Incident Response

* Monitor, triage, investigate, and respond to security alerts generated from MDR, SIEM, endpoint protection, cloud security, and identity security platforms.
* Conduct incident investigations, collect forensic evidence, analyze root causes, and document findings in accordance with established procedures.
* Coordinate containment, remediation, recovery, and communication activities related to cybersecurity incidents.
* Develop recommendations to improve security controls, monitoring capabilities, and response procedures based on incident findings.
* Assist with proactive threat hunting and security investigations.
* Maintain incident response documentation, playbooks, procedures, and lessons learned.

Vulnerability Management

* Own the vulnerability management lifecycle including identification, prioritization, remediation tracking, validation, risk acceptance, and reporting.
* Coordinate with IT, Engineering, and system owners to ensure timely remediation of identified vulnerabilities.
* Facilitate vulnerability review meetings and track remediation performance against established targets.
* Analyze vulnerability trends and provide risk-based recommendations to management.
* Assist with implementation of security hardening recommendations across endpoints, servers, cloud services, applications, and network infrastructure.

Security Projects & Continuous Improvement

* Coordinate cybersecurity projects from planning through implementation and operational transition.
* Develop project plans, timelines, status reports, risk registers, and implementation documentation.
* Support deployment and optimization of security technologies including identity management, endpoint security, email security, vulnerability management, monitoring, and cloud security solutions.
* Participate in evaluation, testing, and implementation of new cybersecurity technologies and controls.
* Coordinate activities with third-party vendors, consultants, and service providers supporting cybersecurity initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to improve security controls, operational processes, automation, and overall cybersecurity maturity.
* Support strategic cybersecurity roadmap initiatives and continuous improvement programs.

Identity & Access Management

* Support enterprise identity and access management processes including user provisioning, access reviews, privileged access management, conditional access, and authentication controls.
* Assist with monitoring, investigation, and remediation of identity-related security events and risks.
* Participate in implementation and continuous improvement of identity governance, least privilege, and zero-trust security initiatives.

AI Governance & Data Governance

* Support the organization's AI Governance Program by assisting with the evaluation, monitoring, and secure adoption of artificial intelligence technologies and services.
* Participate in cybersecurity reviews and risk assessments of AI-related use cases, applications, vendors, and third-party services.
* Assist with development and implementation of security controls, standards, and policies related to responsible AI usage.
* Support enterprise Data Governance initiatives, including data inventory, classification, labeling, retention, protection, and lifecycle management activities.
* Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to identify and classify sensitive corporate, customer, employee, financial, and regulated data.
* Participate in implementation and administration of Data Loss Prevention (DLP), data classification, information protection, and data labeling capabilities.
* Assist in monitoring, reporting, and remediation activities related to data governance and information protection controls.
* Support implementation and ongoing management of Microsoft Purview and other information protection technologies.

Compliance, Risk Management & Customer Security

* Participate in cybersecurity risk assessments and remediation planning activities.

---------------------

RISCPoint is seeking a Security Operations Analyst responsible for supporting and maintaining the ongoing security and compliance posture of FedRAMP-authorized information systems through the execution of continuous monitoring, vulnerability management, and security operations activities. This role includes proactively identifying, analyzing, and responding to security events and incidents, performing regular vulnerability assessments and remediation tracking, and ensuring system configurations, controls, and documentation remain aligned with FedRAMP, NIST, and organizational security requirements. The Security Operatins Analyst collaborates with engineering, compliance, and operational teams to validate control effectiveness, support audit and assessment activities, and maintain accurate system security documentation, including SSP updates, POA&M management, and risk reporting. This position plays a critical role in safeguarding federal data, ensuring regulatory compliance, and strengthening the overall resilience and security maturity of authorized cloud environments.

**Qualifications**
------------------

Experience:

* 2-4 years in security operations, incident response, or SOC analyst role
* 1-2 years working in AWS, particularly AWS GovCloud
* Experience with vulnerability management and remediation
* Hands-on experience with SIEM platforms and security monitoring tools

new_jobs.description:
**Why Epicured?**

Epicured is on a mission to combat and prevent chronic disease, translating scientific research into high-quality food products for patients nationwide. Our evidence-based approach brings the best of the clinical and culinary worlds together to help people eat better, feel better, and live better one meal at a time.

**About Epicured**

Epicured helps prevent and manage chronic disease through medically tailored nutrition, combining clinical research with culinary expertise to improve health outcomes nationwide. Join a mission-driven team working at the intersection of food, healthcare, and technology.

By joining our team, you’ll contribute to meaningful initiatives at the intersection of food, healthcare, and technology — helping to improve access, reduce complexity, and directly impact the lives of people managing chronic health conditions.

**Position Overview**

Epicured is seeking a Culinary & Recipe Data Analyst to serve as a system manager and technical backbone for our recipe database in Galley. In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end input, audit, and management of recipe data across all of our business lines.

Working directly with our Culinary Product Manager, you will follow established SOPs to ensure that every dish—from raw ingredient sourcing and vendor mapping to nutrition profiles and clinical allergen tags—is accurately modeled in Galley.

This is a critical role that directly unblocks our culinary backlog and optimizes product development. You will protect the integrity of our database architecture, support our cross-functional workflows, and have room to grow into broader product and data analysis responsibilities within the department.

**Responsibilities**

* Recipe Data Management - input, standardize, and maintain detailed recipe specifications across all business lines within the Galley platform according to company SOPs.

* Cross-Functional Data Quality - partner with culinary, clinical, and operation teams to audit existing recipes, correct discrepancies, and perform regular quality assurance checks on menu data.
* Process & System Support - identify operational bottlenecks in recipe data entry, assist in refining SOPs, and ensure data consistency to support downstream menu planning and rotation, nutrition review, and labeling outputs.

**Qualifications**

* Industry Experience: 2-3 years of food industry experience; whether through commercial kitchen/culinary experience, a background in food regulation, or work as a Registered Dietitian.
* Education: a degree in Food Science (preferred)
* Systems / Data Literacy: Proficiency in database entry or food management platforms (Galley experience is a huge plus, but other system experience is welcome).
* Eager to learn, adapt, and scale responsibilities within culinary operations / product development within the organization.
* Technical / Analytical Skills: Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets for data manipulation, cross-referencing, and basic analysis.
* Meticulous approach to data integrity, numbers, unit conversions (yields, serving sizes, weights), and technical ingredient and recipe specifications

* 401(k)

new_jobs.title: Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
##### **About BigHand**

BigHand offers technology solutions for busy legal professionals that provide data and insights to increase value and profits. Through our expert knowledge and innovative technology, we enable our customers to achieve enhanced efficiency, better decision-making and harness their competitive edge.

We build with tomorrow in mind, transforming ideas into action and empowering our customers to succeed in a world of constant change. We make big happen for our customers.

We are a business driven by our values and have these at the centre of everything we do. Our BigHanders are dedicated to building a culture where We Win Together, We Love to Learn, We Do the Right Thing, We Own It and We Find the Fun.

##### **About the role**

This role exists to turn BigHand's revenue data into reporting and insight the business runs on. You'll join a small Revenue Operations data team that owns our Azure data warehouse, Power BI reporting and AI tooling, and you'll work with stakeholders across the company.

This is a hands-on role for someone with experience in Power BI, SQL and Azure data tools, including Microsoft Fabric as our platform evolves to hit the ground running from day 1. You'll get mentoring from experienced data practitioners, work on numbers that leadership and the board use to make decisions, and grow into a well rounded data professional in a B2B SaaS business.

##### **What you’ll do**

* Build, maintain and improve Power BI reports and dashboards covering pipeline, bookings, ARR, renewals and customer health.
* Write and optimise SQL queries against our Azure data warehouse to answer ad hoc questions.
* Support Azure Data Factory pipelines: monitor scheduled runs, troubleshoot failures and help add new data sources and tables.
* Help keep data accurate and consistent across Salesforce, NetSuite, marketing automation and other source systems, flagging and fixing quality issues.
* Support with recurring reporting packs, including monthly and quarterly metrics.
* Document data models, metric definitions and processes so reporting is trusted and reusable.
* Work with the wider BigHand team on AI-assisted analytics and automation projects as they come up.

##### **What we’re looking for**

* At least 2 years experience in a data, BI or analyst position.
* Hands-on Power BI experience: building reports, basic data modelling and writing DAX measures.
* Working SQL for analysis: joins, aggregations, filtering and common table expressions.
* Some exposure to Microsoft Azure, ideally a data warehouse or SQL database environment.
* Some experience with Azure Data Factory or similar, such as building or maintaining pipelines.
* A careful eye for detail and a habit of sense-checking numbers before they're shared.
* Clear communication, including explaining data to non-technical colleagues.
* Curiosity and a willingness to learn quickly in a fast-moving team.

##### **What** **we offer**

* 25 days holiday (exc. bank holidays) + 3 BigHand days off between Christmas & New Year
* Various wellbeing benefits including private medical, vision, online wellbeing programs & webinars, access to online therapy and Employee Resource Groups (ERG)
* Company-wide Wellness day, for our teams all across the globe to switch off and spend the day doing something to nourish their mental health
* Opportunities to give back with company volunteer events and individual volunteer days
* Career growth opportunities and study leave allowance
* Family benefits including enhanced parental leave, secondary caregiver leave and fertility support
* Financial benefits including pension scheme, life assurance, and salary sacrificing
* Cycle to Work Scheme and Tech Scheme
* Growing business with a global presence, flexible working, modern offices, and remote work options

##### ***Our*** ***DEI Commitment***

*We welcome the unique value and individuality that you can bring to BigHand. We are an equal opportunity employer and are dedicated to recruiting solely based on capability and potential regardless of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, educational background, national origin, religion, military status or physical ability. Our BigHanders are dedicated to advancing our culture of belonging by embracing differing viewpoints, opinions, thoughts, and ideas.*
